# Copilot instructions

The single source of truth for how to work in this repository is **[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** at
the repo root. Read it first and follow it for every task. This file does not restate or override
those rules.

Key pointers:
- Living spec: `.agent/spec/` (one living spec — do not create a folder per feature).
- Reuse inventory: `.agent/capabilities.md` (reuse, don't reinvent).
- Learning log: `.agent/learnings.md` (read first, append when done).
- Standards: `.agent/standards/` (apply a language standard only to that language's files).
